signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own Learning Technology product direction and investment choices across voice, AI platform and evaluations, learner memory, and generated-content quality.
Work with Core Learning to identify which changes in model behavior, lesson quality, personalization, or real-time interaction would most improve Tutor use and learning.
Decide when to adopt a new model, fine-tune one, build a specialized capability, or use an external service, weighing quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
Shape evaluation and release decisions for learner speech and real-time voice, including ASR, TTS, and new conversational models. Connect model benchmarks to performance in actual…
Set product requirements for the Tutor agent harness, model-serving and shared AI tooling, prioritizing the reliability and capabilities product teams need over unnecessary…
Own product strategy and roadmap for learning outcomes and proficiency.
Talk directly with learners and B2B customers to understand how they judge progress today and where the current experience fails them.
Decide which signals of proficiency and progress are trustworthy enough to drive product decisions.
Ship improvements in assessment, progress, and feedback that help learners understand where they are and what to do next.
Connect measurement back to the learning experience so what we know about a learner changes what Speak does for them.
Own the content generation and quality product roadmap
Design and ship authoring, generation, QA, evals, and content improvement loops for internal and external users
Build product workflows for human expert review, automation, and quality gates
Partner closely with curriculum, AI, engineering, product, and learning teams
Define evals and ship/no-ship criteria for AI-generated lessons, feedback, and content variants
